The Python tab of [Convert between formats](convert.qmd). Its cells are
embedded there by label; this file is rendered by Jupyter in its own process,
separate from the R and shell chunks.

```{python}
#| include: false
import os

os.chdir(os.environ["SCX_DOCS_WORK"])
```

```{python}
#| label: py-inspect
import picklerick as pk

info = pk.inspect("tiny_v4.h5seurat")
{key: info[key] for key in ("format", "n_obs", "n_vars", "obs_cols")}
```

```{python}
#| label: py-convert
pk.convert("tiny_v4.h5seurat", "tiny_py.h5ad")
```

```{python}
#| label: py-check
import anndata as ad

ad.read_h5ad("tiny_py.h5ad")
```
